question: How many employees did ZoomInfo say its May 2026 restructuring would affect?

hits.snippet: ZoomInfo Technologies Inc\. \(\) announced Monday that its board of directors approved a restructuring program expected to reduce operating costs and increase operating leverage\. The plan includes a global reduction in force of approximately 600 employees, representing about 20% of the company’s workforce at the end of the first quarter\. According to a statement filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission, about one-fourth of the affected roles will be reallocated to or offset by hiring in different locations\. The company expects the restructuring program to be substantially complete by the end of 2026, with most related charges to be incurred in the second and third quarters of this year\. ZoomInfo estimates that it will incur aggregate pre-tax charges between $45 million and $60 million in connection with the restructuring, most of which are expected to result in cash expenditures\. These costs primarily include one-time termination benefits such as severance payments and related employee benefits\.
